change_rules.MAJOR: Scientific construct or estimand redefinition breaking compatibility
change_rules.MINOR: New falsifiable mechanism, metric or test protocol
change_rules.PATCH: Editorial, attribution, citations, translation, routing, no claim-scope expansion
change_rules.all_versions: Record dates, primary-source antecedents, independent challenges, negative results, provenance, and uncertainties; version does not imply scientific confirmation

history.change: Initial bilingual resonance/value formation conceptual documents; no tests
Named RVD, stabilized hypothesis IDs RVD-R1 through RVD-R5 and version governance; existing empirical status unchanged

next_gate: Original-author literature deduplication and critical crosswalk before any independently preregistered RVD-R1 matched-baseline evaluation; no implied schedule
contribution_boundary: Human originator's resonance concept; AI-assisted organization and version record. Historical quotations from earlier AI summaries not independently re-read.
